title: The Brain Unclogger
description: Dump everything in your head. It sorts it into do, decide, delegate, remember and ignore, without turning every thought into another task.
promise: Dump everything currently occupying your brain.
what_it_does: You dump everything. It separates it into five piles:
when_to_use: When your brain is full and you can't tell what's urgent anymore.
Before you try to plan the week.
When ideas are living in 14 tabs, three Notes files and a Slack message to yourself.
what_to_give_it: Voice-to-text is fine. It doesn't need to be organized. That's its job.
what_you_get: Your brain dump sorted into do, decide, delegate, remember and ignore.
The decisions pulled out on their own.
An ignore pile you're allowed to actually ignore.
what_it_does_after: The point is to turn mental clutter into something you can act on. Not to turn every thought into another task.
